details.message: Update check completed for site 27. Found 5 plugins ready for update (2 blocked/unavailable), and WordPress core update available (7.0.4 → 7.1). Proceeding to plugin update queue.

Health check was healthy and 5 plugin updates were available, so update-all-plugins-tool was invoked for site id=27 with create_backup=true and run_health_checks=true. First attempt failed with "No recent backups found" — a full backup (batch_20940cd83f5df865) was triggered via create-backup-tool and polled every ~2 minutes for 5 checks (~10 min), but it never left "running" status within that window (no completed backup was confirmed by the poller). Re-invoking update-all-plugins-tool anyway succeeded: the site's own backup requirement was satisfied and it queued a plugin update batch (batch_6492aadbd14f8a5a) covering 5 updatable plugins — Activity Log, EWWW Image Optimizer, Rank Math SEO, WPCode Lite, and Advanced Custom Fields PRO. 2 plugins were blocked and NOT queued: Responsive Menu (on blocked list, license needs verification) and Rank Math SEO PRO (update package unavailable — license key missing/expired). Batch is async and currently queued/processing — next workflow step should monitor batch_6492aadbd14f8a5a via check-batch-status-tool (2-minute interval, up to 5 checks) until it reaches a terminal state (success/failed/cancelled) before sending the plugin update email.

update-core-tool call failed for site id=27 (target version 7.0.4 -> 7.1). The MCP tool mcp__smartsites-maintenance__update-core-tool was invoked 3 times (once with version="7.0.4 → 7.1" as specified, twice more as retries including version="7.1") and returned the same error each time: "An internal server error occurred." No batch_id was returned since the call never succeeded. This is the tool's actual error response, not a fabricated result. Recommend checking the smartsites-maintenance MCP server/backend health and retrying the core update step, or manually verifying site id 27 is valid via site-info-tool before retrying.
